title: Applicationcomponent satisfies Requirement
description: The application component meets a requirement directly, such as a component that exists to enforce isolation, caching or a lifecycle rule the requirement states. Prefer applicationservice satisfies requirement when the requirement is about behaviour the component exposes as a service.
x-dr-evidence: ArchiMate 3.2 Appendix B: realization is allowed from an application component to a requirement.
DR already allows data-model.objectschema satisfies motivation.requirement and api.operation satisfies motivation.requirement.
